# RateMyDegrees

RateMyDegrees is a platform for honest, verified reviews of academic programs and institutions. We help students make informed decisions by sharing real experiences, outcomes, and ROI data.

## Key Sections
- /majors: Catalog of degree programs and outcomes.
- /institutions: Database of US higher education institutions.
- /write-review: Where students share their verified experiences.

## URL Structure
- Major Pages: /majors/[cip4]
- Institution Pages: /institutions/[unitid]
- Program Detail Pages: /majors/[cip4]/[unitid]

## Canonical URLs
All pages should use the absolute URL at https://ratemydegrees.com as the canonical source.

## Contact
For inquiries or support, please visit our main site.
